about: Catalogue of everything SonoraOS needs, front -> module -> item. Rendered by tools/progress.py into planning/PROGRESS.md. An item is done only when it is merged to main AND verified; done needs evidence, doing needs a branch. Sizes: S=1, M=3, L=8 points. Two fronts, two milestones (owner, 2026-10-13): Complete DAW, built first, then OS packaging. 'phase' is the stage in planning/ROADMAP.md. 'ref' cites the Avid or Apple documentation the feature's behaviour comes from (PT-RG: Pro Tools Reference Guide; LP-UG: Logic Pro for Mac 12.3 User Guide); behaviour only, never code or content (ADR-0004).

phases.1: DAW 1: engine core, contracts, model, session file
phases.2: DAW 2: editing and mixing in the Qt UI, on the laptop
phases.3: DAW 3: recording workflow, playlists and comping
phases.4: DAW 4: full mixer, processing graph and automation
phases.9: DAW 9: Logic creative tools and content
phases.10: DAW 10: control surfaces, sync and video
phases.12: OS 1: bootable image and target hardware

items.title: Plugin delay compensation: 2048-sample track lands sample-aligned
items.evidence: PR #48: ADR-0012 checklist 3. NodeKind TrackSource/InsertChain/TrackFader (inserts pre-fader), InsertChain nodes carry channel slot, generation, param store index (A2.5) and latency; plan builder computes per-edge delay_frames by §7.3; delay-line pool capped by max_delayed_edges (auditor L3), lines kept per stable-id pair across plans, stable ids keyed on the model track (not its position), a line restarted from silence after any unwritten callback, the pool restored when a pending plan is cancelled; over max_delay_frames clamped and reported as shortfall in the state block (header and kTrackCompensationShort per track), not refused. InsertChainRunner begin/run/end once per callback (bypassed and counted above max_block_frames), node_state in the node, plans bounds-checked on adoption. ctest plan_pdc: a 2048-frame chain, a 100-frame chain and a dry track land sample-exact at the bus on a declared-latency test runner, clamp, pool cap, latency change by swap keeps the delay line, delayed-undelayed-delayed restarts from silence, ids follow the track, zero allocations and frees (new, malloc family) in Session::process; playback_control builds chains from the model, follows a reorder, republishes on a latency change, a cancelled plan leaves the pool alone. tools/build-engine.sh 146/146; tools/test-engine-docker.sh PLAYBACK PASS on every run (see PR)
